 Anwar's defamation suit against PAS deputy president Tuan Ibrahim begins in May 2027 
 TheEdge 
 Wed, Nov 18, 2026 12:34pm - 5 hours 
 View Original 
 KUALA LUMPUR (Nov 18): Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim’s defamation suit against PAS deputy president Datuk Seri Tuan Ibrahim Tuan Man will start on May 11 next year. 
 Anwar is suing Tuan Ibrahim over allegedly defamatory remarks made during a political speech at Felda Jenderak Utara, Kuala Krau, Pahang, on or around June 14, where he allegedly accused the prime minister of abusing his power to influence police investigations and interfering in the appointment of the Yang di-Pertuan Besar of Negeri Sembilan, among other claims.
 The remarks were allegedly recorded and circulated on social media, including Facebook and YouTube.
 During a case management hearing on Wednesday, the High Court set the trial dates for May 11 to 14 and May 28, 2027.
 The court instructed the parties to file pre-trial documents by Dec 18. 
 Anwar’s lawyer, Datuk Sankara Nair, confirmed the matter to The Edge after the case management on Wednesday. 
 Anwar is seeking general, aggravated and exemplary damages for slander and/or slander per se and, alternatively, libel and/or libel per se, as well as a court order to stop Tuan Ibrahim from repeating the allegations. 
 He also wants the removal of the disputed publications from social media platforms within Tuan Ibrahim’s possession, custody or control.
 The claim also seeks interest, costs and any other relief deemed appropriate by the court.
